meta.name: Dig Inn
meta.disclaimer_extra: DIG's chart lists single bowl-portion servings (Fall 2026 menu, updated September 9, 2026); a la carte vegetable sides average 1.5 servings. Menu rotates seasonally.
meta.blurb: Build a DIG bowl the way the market line works — base, market sides, a main and sauces — including every seasonal plate and bowl.

consistency.extras_kids: Little Digs is a kids portion with its own smaller build, not a size of the bowl this page builds.

charred-chicken.reason: The Fall 2026 chart prints 4 g protein for 4.3 oz of skinless charred chicken thigh at 370 kcal, 19 g fat and 1 g carbohydrate; those macros account for about 190 kcal, so the row contradicts its own calorie figure, and a chicken portion cannot carry 4 g of protein. Hot Honey Chicken and Crispy Chicken, the chain's other chicken mains, each print 40 g, so that is the figure used. The row as a whole is doubtful: 370 kcal is high for that weight of thigh, and the chain's summer chart printed 230 kcal and 28 g for the same recipe.
